name: Biofall: Survival
detailed_description:
Story

The year is 2030, the world lies in ruins following the end of World War 3.. and civilization.


We all believed that the apocalypse would be brought on by nuclear weapons.. but its so much worse.



In May of 2025, Rangen Chemical released what was called the “cure". 2 years later after the “cure” was released to the population, people started having horrid reactions, mostly violent, and this was just the beginning. Nations fell as quickly as cities did... You are one of the few that are immune to the cure.


This is ground zero, Ashveil Island, the home of Rangen Chemical. Experiments, Projects, and horrors unknown were made and stored here.




Do you dare risk your life to save the world?


With thousands of items of carefully planned pieces of lore can you find the truth?

Features: Singleplayer, Multiplayer, and server hosting


Interactive world: Everything you see can be manipulated and moved, anything that has some sort of inside or storage will be able to store things (table with a small cabinet on the bottom for example) These things found in world can be scrapped or used as parts to craft other things




Inventory System: Grid-style inventory with unique item shapes. Different Equipment and clothes determine Slots (baggier and bigger stuff will carry more) Containers that can be moved by simple interaction of picking it up (items stay inside) Weight system affecting speed


Base Building and defense system: Hologram placement system. In-depth turret design Turrets (configurable: you start with a base but can configure it to have armor or different guns for different needs) Gun attachments: Flamethrower, MG42, M109, .50 Machine Gun, 10mm AT, Minigun Interactive Turret Building (need to make room for ammo storage, power hookup, guns, feeding belts to storage, and armor hard points)


Realistic Weapons handling and Ballistics: Jams, failure to feed, round drop, material penetration, etc. Mag Check required to see rounds remaining In-depth reloading - Choose the Grain, Bullet Material, Casing Material, and Tip Color in an interactive workbench. (Each choice effects dmg, pen, travel speed etc.)




Combat System: In-depth system for both gunfighting and hand to hand combat. Select and build your own fighting style and combos with the skill tree. Change your attacks, blocks, tactical stance, or even learn skills such as Dual Welding.


Character Creation: 4K Metahuman Face character creation for truly unique characters


Survival Aspect: Hunger, Thirst, and adrenaline. Body health system (damage to extremities effect speed and combat abilities, etc)


Medical and medicine system to heal effects Farming, Hunting, and Fishing

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD FX 4350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 670 or AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
